name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

specs.description:
List of normalization specifications that define how time-series data should be refreshed.

- Default configuration applies to `PointPhysicalMeasurementSeries`.
- Supports batch processing with a default `batchSize` of 1.
- The `force` flag ensures that normalization is applied regardless of prior states.

title:
Defines the specification for refreshing normalization within the reliability risk workflow.

- Controls the normalization of time-series data for reliability analysis.
- Ensures accurate data preprocessing by applying predefined normalization rules.
- Supports workflow execution for batch-based normalization updates.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.RefreshNormalization
